hwd_events.json.note: Runway / helicopter event counts by type, runway end, tower status, class and local hour, with the classifier rules and their cut statistics. Also uses FAA NASR runway data (public domain) via hwd3d/tools/common/hwd_frame.py and OSM features (ODbL) for helicopter places. Aggregates only (default D1, docs/PLAN.md 6a): positions, ICAO type designators, ADS-B emitter categories, source classes, duration buckets (stays) / durations rounded to 10 s (run-up stops) and counts; no ICAO address, registration, callsign or time stamp. The per-aircraft working files stay in refs/cache/local/adsb/ (gitignored).
